newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in thin after-hours trade on Tuesday, helped by the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.6 yen per kg firmer than the day's close. Benchmark June was 0.1 yen up at 146.8 yen.

During the day, private investors retreated to the sidelines as they expected prices to be trapped within tight ranges for the rest of this year. "Weaker yen made sellers cautious, but the upside potential is limited ahead of January when rubber output in producing countries faces a seasonal rise," one trader said. - Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
